newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony says PlayStation shipments top 17.6 mln units.
newsitem.headline: Sony says PlayStation shipments top 17.6 mln units.

text.p: Sony Corp said on Thursday that cumulative shipments of its PlayStation game machine reached 17.6 million units as of June 30, up 4.1 million units since March 31.
Sony senior vice president Masayoshi Morimoto told a news conference that the company's group operating profit was boosted by 20 billion yen in the April-June quarter because of the weaker yen.

Morimoto also said that a boom in the company's electronics business, in which group sales grew 22.2 percent year-on-year in the April-June period, was mainly due to robust sales of its consumer electronics products, including the PlayStation and digital camcorders.
